what_it_is: 3D-printed titanium intra-articular SI joint fusion implant with self-cutting blades. Designed for placement in the articular portion of the SI joint (not ligamentous). Features bone anchors for fixation and stability, fenestrations for bone through-growth, iFuse Lattice Technology for bone ingrowth/ongrowth, and cutting blades that pierce SI joint cortices for initial fixation.
indications: Minimally invasive intra-articular SI joint fusion.
use_notes: Intra-articular placement reduces SI joint range of motion more than ligamentous placement. Single-use instrument set (packaged sterile, no reprocessing). Simple technique designed for reproducibility.
